desc:
🥚 Welcome to Steal a Bird Egg!

How to Play:
🪺 Find and steal Bird Eggs
🐣 Hatch eggs to discover rare animals
💰 Earn money from your animals
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and plot
🪽 Upgrade your Wings and fly faster
🥷 Steal eggs from other players
✨ Discover rarer eggs, sizes, animals, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
